objects.summary: Hosted run 41158223304 on exact head 2f3c1db6 fails after 381 tests at one collection error: tests/test_codex_policy.py imports pytest only for raises, while hosted unittest environment lacks pytest. SEC fail-closed, schema drift and status freshness already pass; failure is dependency-local, not orchestration semantic.

Codex prepares exact dependency-neutral patch replacing pytest with unittest.assertRaises, but stale checkout/no remote prevents application to authoritative head. Patch is transported; no hosted PASS is claimed.

Control loop reconciles remote state and intentionally avoids duplicate Codex instruction while the existing exact repair instruction is still actionable. Status is WAITING_FOR_CODEX_RESULT, not terminal block.

Stale-base worker correctly returns NO_CHANGE_REQUIRED/no mutation because it cannot reconcile authoritative head, preventing a competing implementation. This does not repair the actionable remote defect.

After an additional wake with no repair, Owner classifies the worker STALLED and issues one non-concurrent continuity relaunch, requiring lane switching rather than another reconciliation-only return and targeting the whole hosted qualification block.
Checkpoint records CODEX_RELAUNCHED_AFTER_STALL, preserves exact remote head/run and forbids another concurrent worker while the single relaunch is active.

Relaunched worker builds a fail-closed transport script that verifies each expected pytest expression occurs exactly once before transforming it, but authoritative branch remains inaccessible. Synthetic transform/compile/diff checks pass; remote hosted qualification remains unexecuted.

cross_object_findings.finding: The decisive hosted run reached the full unit suite and failed only because one test unnecessarily imported pytest. Earlier security/schema/projection gates passed. The smallest correct repair is dependency-neutral test syntax, not broader CI/package or orchestration changes.

NO_CHANGE_REQUIRED on a stale checkout prevented a competing branch, which is correct safety behavior; however the actionable remote defect remained unresolved, so the liveness controller later had to classify the worker stalled and relaunch once.

The continuity controller waits through one wake, then issues exactly one relaunch after evidence of stall, explicitly forbidding parallel workers. This is a practical anti-duplication rule grounded in remote state rather than fixed arbitrary retries.

A local fail-closed patch generator and synthetic test are useful transport artifacts but do not change PR #46 or qualify its exact head. Remote application plus hosted rerun remain required before any PASS claim.
